name: Tracera
observation_method: Sequential connected-GitHub inventory and bounded default-history/source reads; selected fields transcribed, not a raw API export.
sampled_commit_scope: Latest default-history item returned at this repository read; not all branches or local state and not an atomic end-of-audit head.
movement: Recent default history repairs invalid mixed uses/run workflow steps and revises the Vercel CLI invocation/pins.
role: Persistent product/system model and dissatisfaction discovery
concerns: CI parsing and deployment tooling fixes are useful but are not the product-model witness.
The older ten-seat plan is now ten workstreams for this one owner, not ten mandatory chats.
ALM/delegation primitives do not replace the intended persistent explanatory product graph.

next_actions.title: Establish one current bounded product-model path
next_actions.work: Reuse the atlas/source records already available; identify actual import, entity/relationship persistence, bounded navigation and discrepancy paths.
next_actions.acceptance: A real repo/capability maps to source/requirements and a genuine discrepancy with correct evidence, not only sample JSON.

next_actions.title: Close durability and consistent interfaces
next_actions.work: Exercise update/reconcile, provenance, unsupported/unknown cases, restart and the same scoped model via UI/CLI/MCP/API.
next_actions.acceptance: State and identity survive restart; tool boundaries respect their actual owners; stale data is visible.

next_actions.title: Qualify real deployment and independent acceptance
next_actions.work: Repair current hosted errors within authorized scope, install/deploy the real frontend/backend, and compare the task with a competent manual/tool baseline.
next_actions.acceptance: Artifact/source/config/route evidence and independent negative oracles; no work-item dashboard substituted for the product.

ecosystem_contract: Keep repo-local source and AgilePlus work authority explicit; ingest portable records, reuse graph/index infrastructure, improve consumers without forcing all projects to wait.
parent_acceptance: An installed/hosted Tracera explains an actual product, finds a substantiated gap, and retains the model through change and restart.
scope_missing: actual chat receipts and read acknowledgement
